headline: Crypto TVL led by Ethereum at $45.8bn on 5 November 2026
summary: Ethereum holds the largest chain TVL at $45.8bn, followed by Base at $6.2bn and Solana at $5.57bn. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest DEX volume at $1.42bn over 24 hours while Tether generated the top fees at $16.8m. USDT leads stablecoins with $177.7bn circulating and Base leads L2 TVS at $14.8bn. Multiple incidents occurred in the prior fortnight including a $6.36bn Binance event and several protocol logic issues.
